activity_summary: Before supper you looked at the precept the clerk had left. It is from Crosby Place, to be read in church on Sunday next, and it forbids blue starch in ruffs. It was not read today.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the sheet and did not add a word.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Has the precept by heart by supper. She does not speak in this stretch.

entities.name: blue starch
entities.context: Mentioned in To be read on Sunday next

entities.name: Crosby Place
entities.context: Mentioned in To be read on Sunday next
